title: CAT 2021 Question Paper (Slot 1, PYQ) - Quantitative Ability - Ratio and Proportion
subject: Quantitative Ability

questions.q: The amount Neeta and Geeta together earn in a day equals what Sita alone earns in 6 days. The amount Sita and Neeta together earn in a day equals what Geeta alone earns in 2 days. The ratio of the daily earnings of the one who earns the most to that of the one who earns the least is
questions.explain:
Let $N, G$, and $S$ be the daily earnings of Neeta, Geeta, and Sita respectively.
From the given conditions:
1) $N + G = 6S$
2) $S + N = 2G \implies N = 2G - S$
Substitute $N$ into the first equation:
$(2G - S) + G = 6S \implies 3G = 7S \implies \frac{G}{S} = \frac{7}{3}$.
Let $G = 7k$ and $S = 3k$.
Substitute back to find $N$: $N = 2(7k) - 3k = 14k - 3k = 11k$.
The daily earnings are $N = 11k$, $G = 7k$, and $S = 3k$.
The one who earns the most is Neeta ($11k$) and the least is Sita ($3k$).
Ratio = $11k : 3k = 11:3$.
